# `ext::cli_complete` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/cli_complete.lani#L4)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Portable borrowed completion over canonical ext::cli prefix classification and ext::cli_commands scopes. Context inspects only completed words and the active cursor prefix, retains no mutable scope scratch and distinguishes pending required values from strict MissingValue errors. Suggestions write whole decoded prefix replacements with explicit identities/ranges, atomic output/position errors and fused iteration; schema/argument/value lifetimes remain caller obligations. Pure no-host contracts and one 67-case native model test pass on Linux x86_64. This module allocates nothing and performs no I/O; the native query separately passes 16 allocation cases (13 reached OOMs plus three baselines) and 12 output cases. Direct public flat/scoped prefix getter execution also passes no-host observation. The separate Bash adapter passes finite function, real PTY and watchdog gates on Bash 5.2/bash-completion 2.11; other shells are not established.
